verdicts.reason: The two candidates are pixel-identical, so they share the same flaws. The photo crop cuts the man's head off at the nose and glasses, so his eyes are gone and the subject reads as a disembodied grin. The lightbulb doodle now sits on his cheek and mouth, and the arrow doodle sits on his hair, both unintended collisions. The molecule doodle runs off the right edge of the canvas. The headline and podcast-host block are well placed and readable, but the hero image is badly cropped, so neither candidate is shippable.
